svg.title: Freight Agent Commission Splits
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-agent-split-ranges; chapter number: 4; title: Freight Agent Commission Splits; subtitle: Share of margin, never of gross, by agent tenure and book; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: 40%-70% of load margin; caption: On a $300 margin at a 60% split the agent keeps $180 and the brokerage $120. The broker carries authority, bond, back office and credit risk.; assumptions note: Percentages apply to margin only. Ask what comes out before and after the split - load board, software, insurance - since the headline rate is not take-home.; note: Sources - Matt Krause (hhT4X32MspU) and FreightBrokers with Connor Harutyunyan of ALG (jgNUpO0VPws).; buckets: label: Low-paying brokerages; low: 40; high: 40; notes: Some brokerages pay 40%.; label: New agents; low: 50; high: 50; notes: New agents typically start near 50%.; label: Agents bringing shippers or volume; low: 60; high: 70; notes: Tenured, high-volume agents reach 60 to 70%.; label: Veteran ALG agent; low: 67; high: 67; notes: Connor Harutyunyan reports about 67% of profit.
